name: Vigilante Dynamic Striker
body:
Some vigilantes want to feel their bare fists smashing across the faces of their foes, eschewing weapons for a more personal approach to combat. They are the iron bodied warriors who stand firm against the assaults of others, their bodies able to take as much punishment as needed to accomplish their goals.

Weapon Proficiencies Dynamic strikers are not proficient with martial weapons. However they do gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. This alters a vigilante’s weapon proficiencies.

Dynamic Specialization (Ex)

A dynamic striker must choose to be either a brawler dynamic strike or a technician dynamic strike.

A brawler dynamic striker is treated as an avenger vigilante for the purpose of their base attack bonus and which talents they can select.

A technician dynamic striker gains the studied combat class feature of an Investigator of their level (with a minimum bonus on attack rolls of +1), This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) or until they deal damage with a knockout blow, whichever comes first. A dynamic striker can only benefit from this ability when making an attack with an unarmed strike, cestus, gauntlet, spiked gauntlet, or rope gauntlet.

This ability replaces vigilante specialization.

Martial Arts Talents (Ex or Su)

A dynamic striker can select from any of the following vigilante talents, in addition to general vigilante talents. A dynamic striker also uses their Wisdom modifier to determine the saving throws of their vigilante talents instead of their Charisma modifier, and if a vigilante talent requires an attack roll, they must make this attack roll with an unarmed strike.

Cross Counter (Ex)

Whenever they successfully deflect an attack with their cross guard, the dynamic striker can spend an additional use of their cross guard to make an attack of opportunity against the foe whose attack they deflected. Only a tactical dynamic strike can select this talent, and they must be 4th level or higher to select this talent.

Crush Counter (Ex)

Whenever the dynamic striker uses their cross counter, if their attack roll exceeds their foe’s AC by 10 or more, it is treated as a critical threat. At 20th level, it is treated as a critical hit. Only a tactical dynamic striker can select this talent, and they must have the cross counter talent and be 14th level or higher to select this talent.

Dynamic Roll (Ex)

Whenever a dynamic striker makes a full?attack action, they can designate it as a dynamic roll. When a dynamic striker makes a dynamic roll, each time they make a successful attack against the same foe, they gain a cumulative +1 circumstance bonus to their attack and damage rolls against that foe until the beginning of their next turn (up to a maximum of the dynamic striker’s Wisdom modifier). Whenever the dynamic striker misses an attack, this bonus is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). At 8th level, if the dynamic striker makes 4 or more successful attacks against the same foe, that foe must make a Fortitude saving throw or become staggered for 1 round. At 14th level, if the dynamic striker makes 6 or more successful attacks against the same foe, that foe must make a Fortitude saving throw or fall unconscious for 1d3 rounds.

After using this talent, the dynamic striker is flat-footed for 1 round or the next time they are attacked. A dynamic striker must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

Effortless Counter (Ex)

Whenever a dynamic striker uses their cross guard to successfully deflect an attack, if their attack roll exceeds their foe’s by 10 or more, the dynamic striker does not need to spend an additional use of their cross guard to use their cross counter. Only a tactical dynamic striker can select this talent, and they must have the cross counter talent and be 8th level or higher to select this talent.

Finesse Fist (Ex)

When making an attack with an unarmed strike, the dynamic strike can use their Dexterity modifier in place of their Strength modifier on attack and damage rolls.

Ki Pool (Su)

The dynamic striker gains the ki class feature of the unchained monk, although if they are not lawful, they can pick a different component of their alignment when they reach 13th level, treating their unarmed strikes as that alignment for the purpose of damage reduction. Technical dynamic strikers can spend 1 ki point to use their cross guard ability.

Ki Power (Su)

The dynamic striker gains a ki power of their choice as per the unchained monk class feature. A dynamic striker must have the ki power talent to select this power, and they can select this talent multiple times, each time selecting a different ki power.

Limited Flurry of Blows (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains the flurry of blows class feature of a monk of their dynamic striker level. After using this talent, the dynamic strike is fatigued for 1 round and cannot use their cross guard ability until the beginning of their next round. Only a technician dynamic striker can select this talent.

Martial Training (Ex)

The dynamic striker can treat their dynamic striker level as their monk level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of feats and also gain a single combat feat for which they qualify.

Shadow Boxing (Ex)

If the dynamic striker has no uses of their cross guard ability, they can spend 5 minutes practicing to regain 1 use of it. Only a technical dynamic striker can select this talent, and they must be 4th level or higher to select this talent.

Speed Study (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains the quick study investigator talent as well as removing the limit on the number of times a dynamic striker can target someone with their studied combat. Only a technician dynamic striker can select this talent, and they must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

Stunning Versatility (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains the stunning fist class feature as a monk of their dynamic striker level.

Style Counter (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains a style strike as per the unchained monk class feature, being able to use it whenever they use their cross counter talent. If the dynamic striker has the style knockout talent, they can use any style strike gained with that talent with their cross counter. Only a tactical dynamic striker can select this talent, and they can select this talent multiple times, each time selecting a different style strike, and must have the cross counter talent to select this talent.

Style Knockout (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains a style strike as per the unchained monk class feature, being able to use it whenever they make a knockout blow. If the dynamic striker has the style counter talent, they can use any style strike gained with that talent with their knockout blow. Only a tactical dynamic striker can select this talent, and they can select this talent multiple times, each time selecting a different style strike, and must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

Style Strike (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains a style strike as per the unchained monk class feature, being able to use it whenever they make a full-attack action. At 14th level, a dynamic striker can use a second style strike while making a full-attack action, either the same style strike twice or another if they select this talent a second time. Only a brawler dynamic striker can select this talent, and this talent can be selected multiple times, each time gaining a new style strike.

Trained Fist (Ex)

The dynamic striker gains weapon training 1 for the close weapon group, although they treat the close weapon group as including only unarmed strikes, brass knuckles, cestuses, gauntlets, spiked gauntlets, and rope gauntlets. Only a brawler dynamic striker can select this talent, and they must be 8th level or higher to select this talent.

Vacuum Fist (Su)

The dynamic striker can attack foes 15 ft. from themselves, attacking with their raw ki. At 8th level, this range increases to 30 ft. At 14th level, this range increases to 45 ft. This talent is treated as a ranged attack of one size smaller than the mercurial duelist for how wind and other effects affect it. A dynamic striker must have the ki talent to select this talent.

This ability alters vigilante talents.

Dynamic Training (Ex)

At 3rd level, a brawler dynamic striker gains the vicious impact ability, while a technician dynamic striker gains the cross guard ability.

Vicious Impact (Ex)

A brawler dynamic striker’s unarmed strikes deal damage as though they were a monk of their dynamic striker level.

Cross Guard (Ex)

A number of times per day equal to the dynamic striker’s Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), when a creature being targeted by their studied combat makes an attack against the dynamic striker, the dynamic striker can attempt to deflect that attack. The dynamic striker makes an attack roll as though making an attack of opportunity; for each size category the attacking creature is larger than the dynamic striker, the dynamic striker takes a –2 penalty on this roll. If their result is greater than the attacking creature’s result, the creature’s attack automatically misses. The dynamic striker must declare the use of this ability after the creature’s attack is announced, but before its attack roll is made. A dynamic striker can only use this ability with an unarmed strike, cestus, gauntlet, spiked, gauntlet, or rope gauntlet.

Each time the dynamic striker confirms a critical hit or reduces a creature to 0 or fewer hit points with an unarmed strike, cestus, gauntlet, spiked gauntlet, or rope gauntlet while in the heat of combat, they regain 1 use of this ability (up to an amount equal to their Wisdom modifier). Confirming a critical hit or reducing a creature to 0 or fewer hit points against a helpless or unaware creature or on a creature that has fewer Hit Dice than half the dynamic striker’s character level does not restore a use of this ability.

This ability replaces unshakable and frightening appearance.

Advanced Dynamic Technique (Ex)

At 5th level, a brawler dynamic striker gains the dynamic flurry ability while a technician dynamic striker gains the knockout blow ability.

Dynamic Flurry (Ex)

A dynamic striker gains the flurry of blows class feature as an unchained monk of their dynamic striker level.

Knockout Blow (Ex)

A dynamic striker gains the ability to pick out the most vulnerable point on a foe. They can make a knockout blow against the target of their studied combat as a free action, upon successfully hitting their studied target with a melee attack, to deal additional damage. The damage is 1d6 at 5th level, and increases by 1d6 for every 3 levels thereafter (to a maximum of 6d6 at 20th level). The damage of a knockout blow is precision damage and is not multiplied on a critical hit; creatures that are immune to sneak attacks are also immune to knockout blows.

The dynamic striker must be able to see the target well enough to pick out a vital spot and must be able to reach such a spot. A dynamic striker cannot use knockout blow against a creature with total concealment.

This ability replaces startling appearance and stunning appearance.

Perfect Dynamic Mastery (Ex)

At 20th level, a brawler dynamic striker gains the perfect strike ability, while a tactical dynamic striker gains the perfect knockout ability.

Perfect Strike (Ex)

A dynamic striker ignores all damage reduction and hardness on attacks made with their unarmed strikes.

Perfect Knockout (Ex)

A dynamic striker can spend 1 use of their cross guard to maximize all damage done with their knockout blow.

This ability replaces vengeance strike.

Exposed Vigilante

While some hide behind the guise of another identity, exposed vigilante have tossed aside such cowardly tactics, instead standing proud with no fear of being unmasked. They are the warriors who know no fear, instead marching forward to stand against their foes with their own face.

Lone Identity (Ex)

Rather than focusing on maintaining a second identity, an exposed vigilante instead prefers to focus on their skills. A vigilante gains 1 additional skill point for each vigilante level they possess as well as an additional social talent at 1st level. This ability replaces dual identity and seamless guise.

Social Talents (Ex)

An exposed vigilante cannot gain the following social talents: case the joint, everyman, feign innocence, immediate change, many guises, quick change, or any other that would rely on them possessing more than 1 identity, although they are always treated as though they were in their social identity for the effects of social talents.

Special: A vigilante who has had their identity exposed can spend 1 week to gain this archetype, trading out all social talents that require a second identity with new ones. A vigilante with this archetype can also spend 1 week to remove this archetype, losing the additional skill points and social talent gained with this archetype in the process. A vigilante can only gain or lose this archetype once in this fashion.
